body.x: iGIS has presented its ICT and drone solution iGIS-Drone in CES 2019, the largest technology show in the world held in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 to 11.

iGIS, which stands for innovative GIS, developed an ICT solution based on the geographic information system and is currently developing a space information service of the central ministry of government. IGIS is actively upgrading and developing its own GIS solution (iGIS).
Also, the first public exhibited iGIS-Drone can run autonomously through an application so anyone can operate it, and it can reduce redundancy of filming by 3D flight function.

Video or photo filmed through iGIS-Drone can link with management system which makes it easy to manage, and performance of task through the drone can be developed. Additionally, iGIS-Mobile can easily maintain and manage the facility.

With the support of concurrent license, many users can use iGIS without additional payment, and it provides easy UI environment. Furthermore, it provides Schema auto-editing function and enables support for additional development. Due to the user-friendly environment, structured editing efficiency is enhanced, and its excellent compatibility with CAD can make easy structured editing without going through many steps of editing.

Besides these functions, iGIS-Forest is a solution fit for the forest industry, and it can analyze all the forest-related works and information as well as design program installed for forest trail and log transportation trail.
